name: Gemini Video Analysis Setup
description_md:
Find useful moments in a recording and check the evidence before you use it.

Setup: A copyable instruction for building a local Gemini video-analysis tool. Prompts: Four jobs covering sales calls, interviews, meetings and short-form reviews. Comparison: A worksheet for checking accuracy, time and usage.

Free ZIP with Markdown instructions and a CSV worksheet. Based on official documentation; end-to-end execution has not been tested. Model usage may cost extra.
